# OpenSource Overture Maps API

> A hosted, open-source REST API for Overture Maps Foundation data. Query billions of places (POIs), buildings, addresses, administrative divisions, base and transportation features with a simple API key — no BigQuery, Athena or SQL required. Also self-hostable on your own GCP account.

Base URL: https://api.overturemapsapi.com
Docs & site: https://www.overturemapsapi.com

## Key concepts

- Authenticate with an `x-api-key` header. A public `DEMO-API-KEY` is available for testing (lat/lng searches near a few demo cities). Free keys come from https://account.overturemapsapi.com.
- Country-level place queries (`country` with no `lat`/`lng`) are paid plans only; Free and demo keys search by `lat`/`lng`/`radius` (up to 25 km). Each plan has a monthly request limit; responses carry `X-Quota-*` headers and a `429` with `Retry-After` when the limit is reached.
- Filter places by `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), `categories`, hierarchy-aware `taxonomy`, `brand_name`/`brand_wikidata`, `lat`/`lng`/`radius`, `min_confidence`, and `operating_status`.
- Contact fields (`websites`, `phones`, `emails`, `socials`) are returned by default. `has_contact` filters to places that have them. `enrichment_fields=brand` adds Wikidata brand details (logo, official site).
- Results are paginated with `limit` + `page`; totals are in the `Pagination-Count` header.
- Output formats: `json` (default) and `geojson`.

## API reference

- OpenAPI spec (JSON, every operation described): https://api.overturemapsapi.com/api-docs.json (copy at https://www.overturemapsapi.com/openapi.json)
- Every docs page as one file: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/llms-full.txt
- Any docs page as markdown: add `.md` to its URL

## Endpoints

- GET /places: search places (POIs) by location, category, taxonomy, brand, name or country: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/places.md
- GET /places/categories: category values and counts for an area or country: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/places-categories.md
- GET /places/brands: brands (chains) and their place counts: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/places-brands.md
- GET /places/countries: countries with place and brand counts: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/places-countries.md
- GET /places/buildings: places with the footprint of the building they sit in: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/places-buildings.md
- GET /buildings: building footprints with height and floors: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/buildings.md
- GET /divisions and /divisions/{id}: countries, regions, localities and neighbourhoods, with boundaries: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/divisions.md
- GET /addresses: address points near a location: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/addresses.md
- GET /base: land use, land cover and water features: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/base.md
- GET /transportation: road, rail and path segments: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/api-endpoints/transportation.md

## Docs

- Intro: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/intro.md
- What is Overture Maps (themes, licences, releases): https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/what-is-overture-maps.md
- Authentication: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/authentication.md
- Use with AI tools (MCP server, custom GPTs, coding assistants): https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/use-with-ai-tools.md
- Pagination: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/pagination.md
- Usage limits: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/limits.md
- Enriched responses (brand details): https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/enriched-data.md
- Pricing: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/pricing (Free $0 non-commercial, 100 requests/month; Premium $25/month, 1,000; Growth $50/month, 4,000; Scale $100/month, 10,000; paid plans include a commercial licence and country-level place queries)
- Explorer (browse the data on a map, copy the API call): https://www.overturemapsapi.com/explorer

- Build a local business directory: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/guides/build-a-local-business-directory.md

- Map every location of a retail chain: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/guides/map-every-location-of-a-retail-chain.md
- Profile a neighbourhood with Overture places data: https://www.overturemapsapi.com/docs/guides/profile-a-neighbourhood.md

## AI tools

- MCP server for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thatapicompany/overture-maps-mcp (tools: search_places, list_place_categories, list_place_countries, search_divisions, find_buildings)
- Errors return `{ statusCode, message, error? }`; the message says how to fix the request. On 429, wait for the `Retry-After` header.

## About

Built by ThatAPICompany (https://thatapicompany.com) to make Overture Maps data accessible to developers of any skill level. Source: https://github.com/thatapicompany/overture-maps-api
